lessons.trigger_condition: On the tablet, BOX Knowledge did not make the game selector visually obvious, and BOX/HIT could display unrelated global HOT rows while a selected expanded game had no COUNTRY_BOX_DATA result.
lessons.prevention_rule: Expose a game-first BOX filter above country/status controls, bind HOT rows to the selected game/country, fall back to verified market/watch rows for expanded TCGs, and explain true zero-result states with safe recovery actions.
validation_required: BOX Knowledge shows a visible registry-driven game selector before country controls
BOX Knowledge state/count cards follow selected game and country
BOX/HIT HOT rows follow selected game and country instead of showing unrelated global rows
expanded games may render verified market/watch evidence when COUNTRY_BOX_DATA has no static row
true zero-result states distinguish missing verified evidence from a broken UI
existing verified data and non-core grading safety boundaries remain unchanged
lessons.safety_boundary: No price, popularity, release, stock, or grading fact is invented; fallback UI uses only local verified market/watch files and non-core grading remains disabled.
